implemented: LIVE_PAPER and SHADOW position increases require a finite, cost-itemized net-alpha forecast and positive holding horizon.
The runner recomputes excess return after fees, spread, and impact and rejects mismatched forecasts or net alpha at/below the configured hurdle.
The threshold is frozen into session configuration and risk-verdict journal evidence.
Below-hurdle candidates become NO_TRADE with the rejected forecast retained in a durable disposition record.
Reductions and closes are exempt; ambiguous SELL effects are rejected and short entries require the hurdle.

commands: ruff check and ruff format --check on the changed Python files
tests.result: 118 tests passed (67 runner/account/replay integration + 51 fixture replay); mypy, Ruff, and Ruff format checks passed.

limitations: Forecast decomposition and costs are caller supplied; the gate verifies arithmetic, not calibration or source evidence.
Not all existing strategy adapters emit the required forecast contract, so those entries are rejected until integrated.
No live-market result or profitability claim is made.
